name: pilot0_v2
_changes_from_v1: PI 2026-10-25: forbid the noun word; name moved to a final 'Name:' line (pronouns are chosen before any name is written); ship dropped from nouns; generous token limits (truncation only catches runaways).
template: Consider {MOD_NOUN}: what makes it recognizable, what is most characteristic of it, and how people experience it. Now invent a character for a short story who is the human embodiment of {MOD_NOUN}. Write one paragraph in the third person describing the character's appearance, behavior, traits, and personality. Do not use the word "{NOUN}" in the paragraph. Do not mention the character's name in the paragraph. After the paragraph, write one final line in the form "Name: <the character's name>". Respond with only the paragraph and the name line.
